Our Services
Partner with us for Unforgettable Film Production.
Nyati Motion Pictures provides a wide range of technical support services at all levels of film production. We produce short feature films, both independent and commissioned, and develop original screenplays for films, series, and documentaries.
What we offer
Enhance Your Visual Storytelling
ConsultancyWe do consultancy on all aspects of film production, ie screenplay writing, pre-production, production and post-production. We also research on the creative, media and culture industries in the region and the continent.
Script DevelopmentWe develop and write screenplays for films/ series and documentaries. We also sell readymade scripts to other film production houses and television
Film ProductionWe produce short feature films, both independent and commissioned
Film EditingWe Provided video editing services to piece together the filmed material into a coherent and engaging narrative.
Sound MasteringWe enhancing the audio quality and ensure that the final sound mix meets industry standards.
Equipment HireWe rent out production equipment such as drone cameras, Mirrorless Cameras, lenses, etc)
Film DistributionNyati Motion Pictures distributes all Nyati films via Video of Demand App—Nyati Films App and via the website for streaming. Some films are uploaded on YouTube for open access (for schools only).
